title: Picker A/B comparison harness — Claude vs ChatGPT-OAuth
goal: Build an evidence-first harness that compares Claude and ChatGPT-OAuth picker decisions on the same target, same evidence, and same safety constraints, then emits a side-by-side report.
scope: Create a controlled validation script that provisions two comparable runs, one configured for the Anthropic picker and one configured for ChatGPT-OAuth, drives both through the same benchmark or authorized target harness, collects picker decision logs, finding counts, canary/proof deltas, and emits a report. This task depends on backlog-436 enabling the ChatGPT-OAuth picker provider branch.
generation_reason: Operator added TASK_QUEUE.md item #387 for a Claude vs ChatGPT-OAuth picker A/B harness. This package backfills the missing repo-backed task file required by backlog validation.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Validation harness only. Do not change picker production decision logic, runner behavior, approval gates, scope gates, finding schema, or prompt foundations.

success_criteria: Metric: harness can run Claude and ChatGPT-OAuth picker configurations against the same target/evidence setup.
Metric: report includes matched picker decision logs, finding counts, canary/proof deltas, and failure reasons.
Metric: no winner is claimed without measured results.
Tests or dry-run mode cover report generation without live target access.
must_not_touch: Capability pack registry / validation / approval / runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Dry-run or fixture mode emits a side-by-side report.
Live or lab mode records explicit target, provider configuration, and comparable run IDs.
Report states limitations and does not infer capability from structure-only checks.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
ANTI_DRIFT.md and SESSION_PROMPT.md must be loaded.
backlog-436 must be complete or explicitly unavailable with a documented fallback.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with validation results and report path.
Promote the next queued package into NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Implementing the ChatGPT-OAuth picker provider branch
Claiming model superiority without measured comparable runs
